§6THE FOUR-STEP CHAIN IS GONE. THIS IS WHAT REPLACED IT.§r
Dust to pellet to rod to assembly used to be four Assembler recipes. It is now §9twenty-three steps§r, and they follow the real industrial process almost exactly: mill the ore, float it, leach it, extract it, calcine it, fluorinate it, enrich it, reconvert it, press it, sinter it, grind it, clad it, load it, bundle it.

§cREAD THIS FIRST IF YOU ARE UPGRADING§r
§9Ten recipes were removed§r - nine Assembler entries and one Mixer entry, the whole dust-to-pellet-to-rod-to-bundle route. §9Nothing you are holding was deleted§r: every pellet, rod and assembly in a chest still works and still buys exactly what it bought before. But §cten Assembler and Mixer setups will stop§r on world load, and every AE2 pattern feeding them goes invalid. No crash, no item loss - the machine simply finds no recipe and idles.
§2Your CENTRIFUGES are safe.§r The eight recipes that shred depleted rods and assemblies back into dust were cut in the first draft of this release and §9put back before it shipped§r, unchanged to the last chance roll. A standing reprocessing array keeps running through the update, and the PUREX Canyon is an upgrade you build when you want one - not a toll gate you must build before your spent fuel has anywhere to go.
The two ratios that mattered are §9preserved exactly§r: §24 pellets to a rod§r and §23 rods to a bundle§r.

§5THE FIVE QUESTS ON THIS ROW§r
  §9Front End§r §8- ore to yellowcake, eight steps, EV§r
  §9Conversion and the Cascade§r §8- yellowcake to enriched UF6, IV§r
  §9The Water Step§r §8- the one recipe the purified-water ladder multiplies§r
  §9Pellets, Rods, Bundles§r §8- back to the items you already know§r
  §9Reprocessing§r §8- what comes back out of the reactor§r

[note]§6The whole chain is drawn on one page.§r §9docs/production-flowchart.html§r in the mod folder shows every step of all four lines, the machine each runs on, and where the water grade enters. Open it in a browser.[/note]

§5THE FOUR NEW CONTROLLERS, AND HOW TO CRAFT THEM§r
All four are §9Assembler§r jobs, each built out of the casing it is walled in - and every one of those casings keeps its stock GT recipe, so there is no bootstrap loop: you can build the Batching Plant before the Batching Plant exists.
  §9Site Batching Plant§r §8EV, 30 s, circuit 14§r
    §28x Solid Steel Machine Casing + 4x Steel Frame Box + 2x Steel Pipe Casing + 2x Conveyor Module (EV) + 2x EV Circuit§r
    §8The cheapest of the four on purpose: it is the one you build FIRST, in order to build the silo.§r
  §9Cascade Hall§r §8IV, 45 s, circuit 15§r
    §28x Tungstensteel Turbine Casing + 4x Tungstensteel Pipe Casing + 4x Electric Motor (IV) + 8x Long Tungstensteel Rod + 2x RhPdPalladium Plate + 4x IV Circuit + 1 ingot molten Platinum§r
  §9Fuel Fabrication Hall§r §8IV, 45 s, circuit 16§r
    §28x Clean Stainless Steel Machine Casing + 4x Tungstensteel Turbine Casing + 4x Robot Arm (IV) + 4x Conveyor Module (IV) + 2x RhPdPalladium Plate + 4x IV Circuit + 1 ingot molten Platinum§r
  §9PUREX Canyon§r §8IV, 45 s, circuit 17§r
    §28x Radiation Proof Machine Casing + 4x Dense Lead Plate + 4x Electric Pump (IV) + 4x Medium Stainless Steel Pipe + 2x RhPdPalladium Plate + 4x IV Circuit + 1 ingot molten Platinum§r

[note]Everything else in the chain runs on a machine GTNH already had - an IsaMill, a Flotation Cell, a Digester, a Chemical Plant, an LCR, a Dehydrator, a Vacuum Furnace, a Forming Press, a Lathe, a Neutron Activator, a Quantum Force Transformer, a Precise Assembler, an Assembly Line and a plain Assembler.[/note]

[note]§6The Enrichment Annex is a HEAD START on this row, not a way round it.§r §98x Uraninite + 2,000 L Hydrofluoric Acid -> 2x Yellowcake§r every 600 ticks - the same §24 Uraninite per cake§r the eight-step front end reaches by hand. It buys you §9Front End§r and nothing else; the line joins at F-09 and everything from there on is compulsory. §8It paid finished Fuel Pellets until 0.24.0, which is why the Reprocessing quest warns anything filtering that bus.§r[/note]
